name: HubSpot
description: Connect your own HubSpot portal(s) to manage your CRM and marketing data from Imperal -- contacts, companies, deals, tickets, products and line items with full CRUD, batch operations and search; associations between records; custom properties; pipelines and stages; owners; engagements (notes, calls, emails, meetings, tasks); marketing lists and form submissions; files; custom objects; webhook subscriptions; plus value-add reports like pipeline health and duplicate-contact detection. Uses your own HubSpot Private App access token -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself. Note: Quotes, Workflows automation, CMS Hub (sites/pages/blogs) and the Conversations inbox are out of scope -- different products/domains within HubSpot.

tools.name: connect_hubspot
tools.description: Connect a HubSpot portal by saving a Private App access token, after checking it actually works. Create the Private App in your HubSpot portal: Settings > Integrations > Private Apps > Create a private app, grant it the CRM/Marketing/Files scopes you plan to use, then copy its Access token here. Non-expiring; you rotate it yourself in HubSpot if needed.

access_token.description: Private App access token from your HubSpot portal (Settings > Integrations > Private Apps > your app > Access token).
access_token.title: Access Token

label.description: Optional friendly name for this portal connection.
label.title: Label

tools.name: disconnect_hubspot

pricing.notes: Fixed platform scale {0, 8, 16, 20, 40, 60}, same reasoning shape as Asana Connector (0/8/16 tiers) and MuleSoft Connector (40/60 tiers), 2026-08-20/21. 0 = access setup (connect_hubspot, disconnect_hubspot, list_connections -- not a HubSpot API operation against portal data). 8 = any single-portal read (list_*/get_*/search_objects/batch_read_objects/sync_check). 16 = standard single write/CRUD action on one record or one link (create/update/archive a CRM record of any type, associate/remove an association, create a property, log/update one engagement, add/remove list membership, upload one file, define one custom object schema, one webhook subscription action). 40 = aggregated value-add reports that scan across the whole portal/pipeline, not a single record (get_pipeline_health, find_duplicate_contacts) -- same tier as MuleSoft's audit_cloudhub_environment/get_stale_applications. 60 = bulk operations touching up to 100 records in one call (batch_create_objects, batch_update_objects, batch_archive_objects, bulk_update_deal_stage) -- same tier as MuleSoft's bulk_* application tools. No Google Cloud markup applies (HubSpot is not a Google-backed API). revenue_split_dev=95 (partner tier, consistent with Asana/MuleSoft/Workato pricing set the same period).
